data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 晨曦床榻的连帽衫初醒呵欠
data.description: 周末清晨明媚的晨曦照亮了卧室。弥子裹在宽大的毛绒连帽衫里，从被单间探出身子。长长的卫衣领口歪斜滑落，露出白皙小巧的锁骨与粉嫩香肩。她微微打着小小的呵欠，水汪汪的棕眸泛着晨起的困倦泪光，像一只软糯的小仓鼠般揉着眼睛，展露出全无防备的极致可爱。
data.action: sitting up in bed yawning cutely with hand near mouth, oversized hoodie slipping off one shoulder, bare collarbone, messy low twintails, tear in eye from yawning, sweet blush
data.lighting: pure cheerful morning sunbeams washing across pastel sheets
data.mood: irresistibly cute morning vulnerability, pure domestic sweetness
data.promptProse: Sitting up in a sunlit bed in an oversized fuzzy hoodie slipping off one shoulder, Miko Iino yawns adorably with a small fist to her mouth. Morning sunbeams illuminate her messy twintails as she looks up with sleepy, affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Miko yawning cutely on her bed in an oversized hoodie as morning sunlight pours in.
